newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes up on wet weather in region.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes up on wet weather in region.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended higher after as sentiment was boosted by the wet weather in Malaysia and other countries of the region, which raised the prospect of tighter supplies ahead, dealers said on Wednesday.
"Prices are likely to improve because the bad weather would tighten local supplies," one dealer said. "Thai supplies will also grow at a smaller rate due to the rains."
Producers were also waiting for better prices as the market expects a shortage of materials, they said.
Traders quoted the SMR 20 at 304, SMR CV at 364, SMR L at 345, SMR5 at 315, SMR 10 at 305-306.
